Application process for the PhD program (Research Phase)
Here you can find the application process for our PhD's program (Research Phase).
The application portal is open now. It will be open until December 1, 2026 for the take-ins in 2027.
Please follow the process described below.
The application process for the Master's program (Study Phase) is also open now.
All further information on the application process for the study phase can be found here: Application Study Phase!
How does the application procedure work?
STEP 1: THE ONLINE APPLICATION
Study or Research Phase?
If you would like to apply for the Master's program (Study Phase), please follow the instructions on this page: Study Phase.
If you would like to apply for the PhD program (Research Phase), please follow the instructions below.
It is absolutely essential that you select the correct program for which you wish to apply (that is, either for the Master’s program (Study Phase) or for the PhD program (Research Phase)!
A. First: Register
Register at the application Portal, and first complete the registration process. Then log in to the portal and choose whether you apply for the research or study phase (please let us know if you are not sure which phase to apply for). It is absolutely essential that you select the correct program for which you wish to apply (that is, either for the Master’s program (Study Phase) or for the PhD program (Research Phase)!
B. Then: Invite your Referees
Add the contact details of at least two referees and invite them ("Submit to Send E-mails to referees" at the bottom of the page) to fill out a reference questionnaire. Doing this first will allow your referees more time to provide their references. You also have the option to upload letters of reference (DOWNLOAD A TEMPLATE HERE). However, the invitation-based reference is considered the default option and strongly recommended.
Please note:
You have to complete this section and trigger the email invitation to your referees at first in order to continue with your application. This will give the referees sufficient time to submit the reference forms before the deadline of submission. Importantly, at least two referees need to be invited to fill out reference questionnaire before you can submit your application. Please add the contact details of two referees who can attest to your research, academic, or professional abilities in the context of your interest in pursuing a graduate degree. We recommend that you personally contact the referee regarding your reference form before triggering the email invitation.
After having filled out the form, press the Submit to Send E-mails to Referees button. An email invitation will then be sent, providing the Referees with all the necessary information to electronically fill out the reference questionnaire.
You will receive an email of confirmation as soon as a referee has submitted a reference questionnaire.
It will not be possible to make any modifications or corrections to the content of this References tab, once the referees have been contacted.
In some cases, email invitations may be directed to the spam folder of a referee's email account. Therefore, it may make sense to confirm with the respective referee that email invitation has arrived in the regular folder.
DEADLINES:
For referee invitation December 1
For referee response December 15
C. Finish your Online Application:
Please fill out the rest of the application form by adding the required information and uploading the required documents. Click Save whenever you add any new content. Please note that you must upload and save each document you need to upload individually using the “Upload” button. You may revisit and modify your application at any time prior to final submission. Once the application is completed you submit it ("Submit Application"). Please make sure that you revised the application thoroughly before submitting. Your application is only considered complete if application and both letters of reference have been submitted before the deadline of application. After submission you will no longer be able to edit your application. Your submitted data will be available to view throughout the application process.
Which documents are required for the online application? ↓ (Click here to find our more)
Unless specified otherwise, all candidates applying for the study phase must provide the following documents
in PDF format:
A copy of the Master's certificate.
If you have not yet finished your degree, you may apply with a preliminary Transcript of Records (ToR) including the marks of all completed courses so far. A brief description of the courses would be helpful.
A Bachelor's certificate with ToR.
A comprehensive and up-to-date curriculum vitae (CV).
Please list all stages of your education chronologically, as well as a clear statement as to your current
status and/or occupation, including information on (un-)employment or parental leave.
A typewritten letter of motivation.
The letter should not exceed 500 words and should describe your personal background,
your interests, and reasons for applying to the MPSP program.
Contact information of at least two referees that will be contacted through our application
portal in order to fill in a questionnaire about you. Letters of reference can also be uploaded.
However, it is strongly recommended to use the invitation-based process.
For further details, check the FAQ.
A copy of your passport or ID card.
Proof of English proficiency.
Please provide one of the following certificates, unless an exemption from the language
requirement applies (see below):
TOEFL or IELTS English test certifying at least CEFR B2 level
Cambridge English Proficiency (CPE) exam or Cambridge English Advanced (CAE) exam
German “Abitur” with comprehensive coverage of the English language
Statement from an academic examination office that you completed/are completing a previous
degree program where the medium of instruction and examination was solely English.
Language exemptions: nationals from the USA, U.K., Ireland, Australia, New Zealand or Canada, as well as B.Sc. or M.Sc. graduates who obtained their qualification in one of these countries, may upload a proof of nationality or a self-prepared PDF file explaining this circumstance in lieu of a language certificate.
If you have questions concerning the application process, please write us an email (photonics@maxplanckschools.de).

STEP 2: THE ONLINE TEST
We will have a look at your written applications and invite promising candidates to participate in an online test.
You will have to choose one out of 3 research articles and prepare for the topic in the days before the test. Then you will have to answer some questions related to the article in an exam provided through an online proctoring service that can be taken anytime during a fixed period of 2-3 days.
Of course, participation in the test is free. You will also receive more detailed information about the test when you are invited to it.
STEP 3: THE APPLICATION INTERVIEW
Those applicants who performed well enough in the online test will then be invited to an application interview. Here, some of our Fellows will talk to you about your (future) research, you may also have to prepare a short presentation (more details will follow when you are invited to the interview). In the application interviews, we try to assign you to those Fellows who work in the research fields you are interested in.
